messages:
Maya (content): Draft is up — https://docs.redwood.ai/launchs/rl-inference-post-draft (TL;DR: angle is 'serving-first economics' with a short benchmark sidebar). please skim — need creative + lead routing decisions by EOD.
Ethan (growth): reading now. quick Q: are we calling out Dedicated vs Hosted for throughput numbers? i'd prefer a single exemplars table not separate product-sells.
Maya (content): good call. one exemplar table with two rows: 95th latency / tokens-per-second for typical LLM prompt. avoids product-sell tone.
Priya (design): I pulled hero options into the doc. Option B leans technical (latency chart), Option A is more customer-story. I recommend B for the benchmark-led narrative. attached small mock. :sparkles:
Carlos (ops): for the CTA and webinar capture — we need the HubSpot form ID and the routing rule. recommend: leads with company size >50 go to AE queue, others go to nurture list. Also add a field: "Workload type" to route for Dedicated interest.
Maya (content): @Carlos can you paste the exact HubSpot form ID and the intended routing logic here so Growth can wire it?
Carlos (ops): Form ID: hs_form_23a9f. Routing rules (short): 1) company_size >=50 -> AE_queue; 2) interest includes "private" or "dedicated" -> Enterprise_CD; 3) else -> nurture. Also set source=blog-launch and utm_campaign=rl_inference_launch.
Ethan (growth): adding mapping to our webhook. priority: add utm_campaign and source tags, and send a "lead_score"=visit_count * 2 + demo_request_flag*10 — can ops add that transform?
Carlos (ops): can do. demo_request_flag -> boolean from form checkbox. visit_count from hidden field populated by script. will document transform in the integration README.
Priya (design): micro-ask — can we get a short hero screenshot of the latency chart (PNG) for the tweet card? need it by noon to schedule.
Maya (content): i'll ping design directly. legal-bot: please note: brief contains a single customer quote placeholder, legal needs customer consent before publish.
Maya (content): noted, i'll replace placeholder with "customer quote pending" until we have sign-off.
Ethan (growth): webinar planning: propose 30-min technical demo + 15-min Q&A. CTAs: "Register" on blog hero -> register modal -> HubSpot form hs_form_23a9f. after register, redirect to /webinar-confirm and send calendar invite.
Maya (content): approvals: can we get final ok from product (cc product@redwood) and legal by tomorrow 11am? if yes, we can schedule publish Weds at 10am PT.
Carlos (ops): one more ops note: add server-side tracking for UTM and include token-level cost snapshot endpoint for benchmarks (to avoid exposing internal metrics). ops will provide anonymized numbers.
Priya (design): will deliver hero PNG and alt text by 11:30.
Ethan (growth): i'm good with routing and tags. i'll prepare the nurture email and webinar drip sequence drafts.
Maya (content): thanks all — Action items: Maya: update draft with exemplar table + placeholder quote; Priya: hero PNG + alt; Carlos: integration README + transform + anonymized benchmark numbers; Ethan: nurture + webinar drips; Legal: final check on quote + compliance. ping here when done. :thumbsup:
Carlos (ops): noted — will post README link once transforms are pushed.
Maya (content): closing loop — will queue for scheduling after legal sign-off.
